notes.title: Polysomnography Report
notes.author: Sleep medicine physician
notes.text:
Polysomnography Report
Date: 06/03/2025
Patient: Bradly Thiel, 75-year-old male

Diagnostic in-laboratory polysomnography performed 06/03/2025. The study included continuous monitoring of brain activity, eye movements, muscle activity, heart rhythm, respiratory effort, airflow, and oxygen saturation throughout the night.

Total apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) 22.4 events/hour. Central and mixed apneas comprised 8% of all events. Oxygen saturation levels showed intermittent drops corresponding to respiratory events, with a nadir of 88%.

Sleep architecture was preserved with normal distribution of sleep stages and no significant periodic limb movements detected.

In summary, the polysomnography confirms moderate sleep apnea with a predominance of obstructive events and a smaller proportion of central and mixed apneas. Clinical correlation and appropriate management are advised.

Sleep Medicine Consultation
Date: 08/26/2026
Patient: Bradly Thiel, 76-year-old male

Reason for Consultation:
Evaluation for sleep-related concerns.

History:
Mr. Thiel is a 76-year-old male presenting for assessment of his sleep patterns and quality. He reports difficulty maintaining restful sleep and frequent awakenings during the night. There is no history of significant daytime sleepiness or other sleep disorders reported.

Physical Examination:
General: Alert and oriented.
BMI 32.4 kg/m2.
No other significant physical findings noted.

Assessment:
The patient exhibits features consistent with sleep disruption possibly related to underlying medical or lifestyle factors. His BMI places him in the obese category, which may contribute to sleep difficulties.

Plan:
Recommend sleep hygiene education and consideration of further diagnostic evaluation including polysomnography if symptoms persist or worsen. Follow-up appointment to review progress and any new findings.

Summary:
Mr. Thiel's sleep concerns warrant ongoing monitoring and supportive management to improve sleep quality and overall health.
